stories.title: South Korea's KOSPI plunges more than 6% and breaks below 6,000, triggering its first sell-side circuit breaker in two months
stories.reason: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares tumbled roughly 7-9% as foreign investors dumped chip stocks on fears that China's CXMT will flood the market with next-generation DDR5 memory, extending a four-session slide that has now wiped out 8.9% from the index.

stories.title: India's opposition marches to the Supreme Court as protests over 130 million deleted voter names escalate
stories.reason: Opposition lawmakers submitted a petition alleging irregularities in the nationwide voter-roll revision, which they say disproportionately strips Muslim and minority voters, as two sitting election commissioners have reportedly objected to deletion decisions at least 14 times over ten months.

stories.title: Meta launches its Muse Wonder AI model, with Zuckerberg claiming it has reached the AI frontier
stories.reason: The release caps a 14-month overhaul of Meta's AI operations under Alexandr Wang's Superintelligence Labs, with Meta claiming the model rivals ChatGPT and Claude on coding and financial tasks even as independent benchmarks still place Anthropic's Opus ahead.

stories.title: Russia strikes Kharkiv with Banderol missiles, collapsing part of an apartment building and injuring at least 11
stories.reason: Regional officials said Russian forces fired roughly 10 of the jet-powered loitering munitions at civilian infrastructure in the Kholodnohirskyi district, trapping several people under rubble before rescuers freed them, in Moscow's second such Banderol strike on the city this month.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia extends Riyadh airport's closure to October 17 and probes air-defense failures after another Houthi missile
stories.reason: The latest intercepted missile came two days after a strike killed at least 13 people and wounded over 300 in the deadliest attack on the kingdom in a decade, as officials investigate why the airport's defenses failed to stop the earlier barrage.

stories.title: Canada's Carney urges Alberta to stay in Canada a week before its secession vote
stories.reason: With the non-binding October 19 referendum asking whether Alberta should begin the legal process toward separation, Carney pointed to a proposed West Coast pipeline and infrastructure projects as reasons to stay, as Premier Smith says separatist support sits near 22%.

stories.title: A 14-year-old shoots a principal and teacher at a French school after hiding a shotgun in a guitar case
stories.reason: A staff member disarmed the student in a stairwell at the Aubagne middle school near Marseille before police arrived, and while both victims suffered non-life-threatening leg wounds, the rare instance of pupil gun violence in France has left the motive unclear.

stories.title: Seventy-four House Democrats demand Pentagon answers on Iran airstrikes that killed civilians
stories.reason: The letter presses Defense Secretary Hegseth chiefly over a September 1 strike on a wedding that killed five and wounded about 70, reviving scrutiny of a February school strike that killed up to 175 people and that the Pentagon's own preliminary probe blamed on outdated targeting data.
